purpose: Offer a playful non-circular eye option using a lopsided bean or egg shape with a fuller lower curve.

arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent cartoon game sprite, eye-shape variation v8
Input images: Image 1 is the high-resolution edit target and is absolute authority for the shark body, pose, scale, framing, gray shading, black outlines, waves, yellow mermaid hair, and transparent canvas. Image 2 is the enlarged nearest-neighbor pixel source and Image 3 is the exact original sprite; Images 2 and 3 are authority only for the playful non-circular eye character.
Primary request: Change ONLY the shark's single visible eye in Image 1. Draw one broadly open, playful lopsided bean-or-egg-shaped white eye with a fuller lower curve and a subtly compressed upper curve, reflecting the quirky asymmetry of the pixel original. Add a round black pupil looking forward/right toward the yellow hair. The expression should read curious, buoyant, and playfully excited, never threatening.
Composition/framing: preserve Image 1 overall placement and silhouette; retain exactly one visible eye at the same facial location.
Style/medium: polished 2D cartoon sprite with the exact existing palette, line weight, highlights, and shading.
Constraints: preserve the shark body, dorsal fin, snout, water, splash shapes, yellow hair, transparent background, canvas dimensions, pose, and crop. The eye must be obviously non-circular and open, with gentle asymmetry. Keep the gray skin above/left of the eye completely clean. No eyebrow or brow crease. No mouth or second facial mark. No second eye. No text or watermark.
Avoid: perfect circle, simple oval, narrow slit, hostile glare, devious expression, dangerous expression, sharp angular eye, eyelid squint, upper stray dark oval, extra facial marks, changing any non-eye elements.
